topic: What frequency planning challenges arise when coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility windows?
consensus_response: Overlapping satellite visibility windows directly increase interference, degrading link capacity. This necessitates sophisticated spectrum allocation and coordination techniques to minimize interference, like dynamic spectrum allocation algorithms. These algorithms adapt to changing satellite orbits and frequencies, optimizing resource utilization and maintaining reliable communication.
reference_context: Increasing satellite density in LEO creates a spectrum crowding problem.  This necessitates efficient spectrum management techniques, including dynamic allocation, cognitive radio, and interference mitigation strategies, to ensure smooth operation of the growing satellite network.
